fusions.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
fusions.desc: Shoves out with the rod, dealing 7 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Its damage rises 10% for each ally near you (max 40%). Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Slow Reckoning
fusions.desc: After a 1.5 second wind-up, sends a heavy bolt that deals 32 damage plus 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Winter Byre
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you and your allies for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Calf at the Heel
fusions.desc: Calls a bonded calf that fights beside you, striking for 3 damage.
